beats.text: Philippines has 2.5 times the high-tech export share of the USA.
We count products with high research and development intensity, like computers and pharmaceuticals.
In the Philippines, 60.3970% of factory exports are high-tech.
Manufacturing giants sit lower. China has 26.2777% and the USA has 24.3230%.
Others trail far behind. Nigeria has 2.7117% and Bhutan has 0.0107%.
